title: In Conversation: The Student Years — James on the Classroom He Came From
dek: Before he taught anyone, he was the one at the back of the room hoping not to be called on. The founder’s own account of the language he was made to study, the pressure that arrived with every report card, the one teacher who changed the temperature of the room, and the years he spent away before he came back. Interview by Alfinur M.

blocks.text: Before the method, before the magazine, before any of it, there was a boy in a classroom being asked a question he could not answer. This interview is the founder’s own account of that room: the language he was made to study, the pressure that arrived with every report card, the one teacher who changed the temperature of the room, and the years he spent away from languages before he came back. Teachers are not named here, and the memories are his own — this is a personal account, not a profile of anyone else.
blocks.say: Before the method, before the magazine, there was a boy in a classroom being asked a question he could not answer. This interview is the founder's own account of that room.

blocks.title: A Research Question for Readers
blocks.content: 💡 If adults who describe a discouraging school experience are asked to retell one classroom memory in the target language, does the retelling change how willing they are to speak in the next session — and in which direction?
